name: jev-compaction
description: Periodic Jev-guided compaction of long sessions: prunes stale tool calls and results and shortens old message text to keep a 1M-context session in a 256k-400k band.

triggerTokens.title: Trigger (tokens)
triggerTokens.description: Windows over 300k tokens: start a periodic compaction when the context reaches this many tokens.

targetTokens.title: Target (tokens)
targetTokens.description: Windows over 300k tokens: a periodic compaction is applied when it brings the context to this size or less.

hardTokens.title: Hard limit (tokens)
hardTokens.description: Windows over 300k tokens: at this size a compaction that cannot free enough falls back to the built-in summary.

triggerPercent.title: Trigger (percent)
triggerPercent.description: Smaller windows: start a periodic compaction at this percentage of the window.

targetPercent.title: Target (percent)
targetPercent.description: Smaller windows: apply a periodic compaction that reaches this percentage or less.

hardPercent.title: Hard limit (percent)
hardPercent.description: Smaller windows: the hard limit as a percentage of the window.

minFreedTokens.title: Minimum tokens freed
minFreedTokens.description: A manual or automatic compaction must free at least this many estimated tokens, else the built-in summary is used.

softMinFreedTokens.title: Periodic minimum freed (tokens)
softMinFreedTokens.description: Windows over 300k tokens: a periodic compaction that misses the target is applied only if it frees this many tokens (a rewrite costs a prompt-cache miss).

softMinFreedPercent.title: Periodic minimum freed (percent)
softMinFreedPercent.description: Smaller windows: the same minimum as a percentage of the window.

regrowTokens.title: Regrowth guard (tokens)
regrowTokens.description: After an attempt, wait until the context has grown by this many tokens beyond it before trying again.

prescoreMarginTokens.title: Pre-scoring margin (tokens)
prescoreMarginTokens.description: From this far below the trigger on, each finished turn asks Jev about part of the backlog, so the compaction at the trigger mostly reuses scores.

prescoreBatches.title: Pre-scoring batches per turn
prescoreBatches.description: At most this many Jev requests are made per turn ahead of time.

prescoreEveryTokens.title: Pre-scoring interval (tokens)
prescoreEveryTokens.description: Pre-score again only after the context has grown by this many tokens since the last pre-score.

prescoreMinQuestions.title: Pre-scoring minimum questions
prescoreMinQuestions.description: Pre-score only when at least this many questions (about one batch) are unscored.

jevTimeoutMs.title: Jev request timeout (ms)
jevTimeoutMs.description: One Jev request is abandoned after this long; the compaction then defers or falls back.

jevTotalMs.title: Jev total time (ms)
jevTotalMs.description: Remaining Jev batches are abandoned (their items are kept) once a compaction has spent this long; also held below the hook's time budget.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability for a tool call, result or message text to be kept verbatim.

abridgeThreshold.title: Abridge threshold
abridgeThreshold.description: Assistant text below the keep threshold but at or above this is abridged; below it, replaced by a one-line stub.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Newest messages kept
preserveRecentMessages.description: The newest messages are never touched (the first message is always kept).

maxStateTokens.title: Jev state ceiling (tokens)
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token ceiling of the conversation state sent to Jev.

maxRequestTokens.title: Jev request ceiling (tokens)
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token ceiling of state plus one batch of questions.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated result head (characters)
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a truncated tool result that are kept.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Model name sent to Jev. Default jev-latest.

keyFile.title: Key file
keyFile.description: Path of a file with KEY=value lines holding AIS_SESSION_COMPACTION_JEV_API_KEY or TYPESAFE_API_KEY. Default: $HOME/.config/ai-tools/jev-compaction.env.

goal.title: Goal
goal.description: Ongoing task description given to Jev; default the last user prompts.
